{{about|the debuff|the support gem|Blind Support}}

[[File:Blind status ailment screenshot.jpg|thumb|A Blinded Rhoa]]

'''Blind''' (known as '''Blinded''' in status icon) is a [[debuff]] that lessens the [[accuracy]] and the [[evasion]] of the affected target by 20% and lowers visual [[light radius]] to its minimum.

==Mechanics==
Blind causes affected targets to have 20% less evasion rating and accuracy rating. It also visually overrides your [[light radius]] to the minimum, though it does not affect the numerical light radius value. The base duration of Blind is 4 seconds. 

Blind's penalty has no effect on chance to hit/evasion chance if [[Resolute Technique]] (or {{c|mod|Hits can't be Evaded}}) or [[Unwavering Stance]] (or {{c|mod|Cannot Evade Enemy Attacks}}) is involved; it will still affect the accuracy/evasion rating value, however.

Blinding a target will also reduce its effective critical strike chance by reducing its chance to succeed [[Critical strike#Accuracy|confirmation rolls of critical strikes]].<ref name=criticals /> 

Blind is not an [[ailment]]. 

===Blind mitigation===
The following sources prevent blind from being inflicted on the character or their minions: (note: {{c|mod|Cannot be Blinded}} does not grant actual [[immunity]], as existing blind debuffs are not removed when one of these sources are equipped or allocated. {{psl|Second Sight}}'s {{c|mod|You are Blind}} is removed immediately, however.)

* [[Soul of Garukhan]]'s upgrade grants {{c|mod|Cannot be Blinded}}.
* [[Saboteur]]'s {{psl|Born in the Shadows}} grants {{c|mod|Cannot be Blinded}}.

{{Item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=item_stats.id LIKE "%cannot_be_blinded"
|large=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

}}

}}
